page.layout: One column of running text, set narrow at the centre-left of the page, with arithmetic workings displayed centred within it. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. The final number "82576" stands right, below the last working. No margin notes.

main_text.p: rectè sub nota secunda, 1 servato: pergo di-cens: bis 6 sunt 12, 1 addito sunt 13, & scribo 3 retinens 1: ac progredior inquiens: bis 3 sunt 6, addito 1 servato, sunt 7. Quibus omnibus conjunctis per additionem, prodeūt[?] horæ anni 8760, hoc modo:
A Christo nato sunt anni 1588. Quæritur quot sint septimanæ? Colloco sic:
A Christo nato sunt septimanæ octua-gies bis millenæ quingentæ septuaginta sex. Quæritur quot sint dies? Colloco sic:

page.notes: The old-style figure 1 in "1 servato", "12,1" and "1588" is set as a small raised "ı" and is copied as 1. The workings are set in lines with rules; each line is given as its own line. The mark over "u" in "prodeūt" is faint and uncertain, hence [?]. The final "82576" stands at the right margin of the text area, below the working, and is copied where it stands. No marginal notes, catchwords or signatures.
